title: 广播三规则与 stride=0 的零拷贝实现
expected_output:
(3, 4)       + (4,)         -> (3, 4)
(3, 4)       + (3, 1)       -> (3, 4)
(3, 4)       + (3,)         -> 失败（shape mismatch: objects cannot be broadcast to a single shape.  Mismatch is between arg 0 with shape (3, 4) and arg 1 with shape (3,).）
(2, 1, 3)    + (4, 3)       -> (2, 4, 3)
(5,)         + (5, 1)       -> (5, 5)
(3, 4)       + (2, 4)       -> 失败（shape mismatch: objects cannot be broadcast to a single shape.  Mismatch is between arg 0 with shape (3, 4) and arg 1 with shape (2, 4).）

=== 尾维对齐：为什么 (3,) 不行而 (3,1) 行 ===
a(3,4) + v(3,)  -> ValueError : operands could not be broadcast together with shapes (3,4) (3,) 
a(3,4) + v(3,1) ->
[[10 11 12 13]
 [24 25 26 27]
 [38 39 40 41]]

=== 广播的零拷贝实现：stride = 0 ===
x.strides              = (8,)
broadcast_to(x,(3,4)).strides = (0, 8)  <- 第 0 维 stride=0：沿行移动地址不变
共享内存: True  -> 广播不复制任何数据
code:
import numpy as np

def try_broadcast(s1, s2):
    try:
        r = np.broadcast_shapes(s1, s2)
        return f"{str(s1):12s} + {str(s2):12s} -> {r}"
    except ValueError as e:
        return f"{str(s1):12s} + {str(s2):12s} -> 失败（{e}）"

pairs = [((3, 4), (4,)), ((3, 4), (3, 1)), ((3, 4), (3,)),
         ((2, 1, 3), (4, 3)), ((5,), (5, 1)), ((3, 4), (2, 4))]
for s1, s2 in pairs:
    print(try_broadcast(s1, s2))

print()
print("=== 尾维对齐：为什么 (3,) 不行而 (3,1) 行 ===")
a = np.arange(12).reshape(3, 4)
v3 = np.array([10, 20, 30])          # shape (3,)
try:
    _ = a + v3
except ValueError as e:
    print("a(3,4) + v(3,)  ->", type(e).__name__, ":", e)
print("a(3,4) + v(3,1) ->")
print(a + v3[:, None])
print()

print("=== 广播的零拷贝实现：stride = 0 ===")
x = np.arange(4)
bt = np.broadcast_to(x, (3, 4))
print("x.strides              =", x.strides)
print("broadcast_to(x,(3,4)).strides =", bt.strides, " <- 第 0 维 stride=0：沿行移动地址不变")
print("共享内存:", np.shares_memory(x, bt), " -> 广播不复制任何数据")
